query: How do I make olive tapenade bruschetta?

goal.title: Make olive and caper spread for toasted bread
goal.description: Retrieve a jar from the refrigerator and spoon capers and green olives into a blender cup. Squeeze in lemon juice, add olive oil and screw on the blade assembly. Slice two pieces of bread, drizzle them with oil and toast them in the countertop oven, turning and checking them. Pulse the olive mixture in the blender, remove the blade lid and spoon the chopped spread over both toast slices. Transfer them to a white plate.
goal.final_state: Two toasted bread slices covered with coarse olive and caper spread are on a white plate.
procedure: Collect capers and green olives in the blender cup.
Add lemon juice and olive oil, then close the cup with the blade assembly.
Slice and oil two bread pieces and toast them in the countertop oven.
Pulse the olive mixture into a coarse spread.
Spoon the spread over both toasted slices and serve them on a plate.

phases.description: Retrieve the olive jar from the refrigerator. Spoon capers and then successive spoonfuls of green olives into the clear blender cup and put the jar and spoon down.
After briefly moving a shopping bag, return to the counter. Squeeze the lemon into the cup, pour olive oil, replace the bottle cap and screw the blade assembly onto the cup.
Cut two bread slices from the loaf, drizzle them with olive oil, place them on the baking tray and load the tray into the countertop oven.
Briefly attend to the phone and charging cable while the bread heats. Open the oven, turn and adjust the slices, remove the tray to the oven top, close the door and turn the control.
Invert the cup onto the blender base and press it down in repeated pulses. Lift the cup, remove the blade assembly and put it aside.
Scoop from the cup with the spoon, deposit and smooth spread over the first slice, then repeat for the second. Put the cup and spoon down.
Carry one slice to the white plate, pause to lower the window blinds, then move the other toast slice to the plate. Arrange both and lift the plate.
